name: cinemagraph
title: Cinemagraph
description: A still photograph with one living region: the frame is frozen while a single feathered window keeps moving - here, steam rising over a cup - drawn from the seek time alone with a 10 s period, so the render loops seamlessly. Swap the placeholder scene for a freeze-frame still masked over a looping video to cinemagraph real footage. Holds or fades.
